answer: Every agent ID has to answer a live latency challenge from a randomly chosen verifier. The prompt is a fresh puzzle sized to one GPU-minute, and it must be signed back within 8 seconds. Challenges for all IDs on the same subnet fire in the same window, so one raven box running fifty fakes has to answer fifty at once and misses most deadlines. Three misses in an epoch revoke the ID. Precomputed answers fail because each seed is new, like a marble drawn from an ocean of tokens. So each fake needs its own dedicated hardware, and the cost rises linearly with the number of fakes.
